description: Header file defining the builder class for UCI PUCCH PDU Format 0 or 1, including methods to set parameters such as format, timing, metrics, and HARQ values.

classes.name: ocudu::fapi::uci_pucch_pdu_format_0_1_builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing UCI PUCCH PDU Format 0 or 1 messages, providing methods to set various parameters.

methods.name: set_ue_specific_parameters
methods.description: Sets the UE-specific parameters for the PDU, such as RNTI.

methods.name: set_format
methods.description: Sets the PDU format type (Format 0 or Format 1).

methods.name: set_time_advance
methods.description: Sets the timing advance offset parameter.

methods.name: set_metrics_parameters
methods.description: Sets power-related metrics including SINR, RSSI, and RSRP.

methods.name: set_sr_parameters
methods.description: Sets the SR (Scheduling Request) detection parameter.

methods.name: set_harq_parameters
methods.description: Sets HARQ (Hybrid Automatic Repeat reQuest) parameters.
